name: Indirect Diffuse Light and Ambient Occlusion Calculation
aliases: Voxel Cone Tracing Indirect Diffuse Illumination
definition: Calculates indirect diffuse light and ambient occlusion by tracing multiple cones from the surface normal to cover the hemisphere.
summary: This method calculates indirect diffuse lighting and ambient occlusion for real-time rendering by sampling the hemisphere with a fixed set of symmetrically spaced cones, distinguishing itself from random Monte Carlo sampling through predetermined directions.
